args.goal: R1 Layer A clean-up before publish: remove unlicensed assets (A1), remove scraping clients plus wreq/BoringSSL from Rust (A2), remove analytics and vendor repo config (A4), then remove scraping providers and third-party provider logos from the frontend (A3). Acceptance per subtask is in the seed file. Workspace-wide Rust check: SQLX_OFFLINE=true CARGO_TARGET_DIR=E:/cargo-target/h0x cargo check --workspace -j 4 must pass on the laptop after A2. Frontend tests: run with `npx nx run-many -t test --skip-sync --projects=<touched>` inside app/frontend; 30 projects already fail at baseline (see HANDOFF) - only new failures block.
args.seed: Read E:/research-clones/h0x-video-studio/docs/agents/seed-R1A.md - it has the 4 subtasks (A1, A2, A3, A4) with exact files and acceptance criteria. Keep those ids. A3 dependsOn A2. A1, A2, A4 must not share files.

questions: Desktop 'image to 3D world' (WorldLabs Marble, enqueue_image_to_gaussian) uses only worldlabs_consumer_client today. A2d deletes it, so the feature disappears. Should R1 rewire it to the official worldlabs_api_client (needs an API key, which is closer to R2 bring-your-own-keys), or leave it out until R2?

The Sora consumer client also powers GPT-Image-1 and Sora 2 when routed through a ChatGPT login. The plan keeps only the artcraft-router GPT-Image-1 path and drops Sora 2 video. Is losing Sora 2 in R1 OK?

Kinovi was the router backend for Midjourney 7/8/Niji, Seedance 2.x, Seedream 5 Pro and the Suno audio models. Deleting kinovi_web_client (ADR-006) removes those routes. Artcraft-router Seedance/Seedream stay. Confirm that dropping the Kinovi-only models (Midjourney via Kinovi, Suno audio) is intended.
